Universal Mechanical Testing Machines - QM 100-600kN
This series offers a strategic solution for laboratories seeking high-quality mechanical testing without the premium price tag of complex hydraulic systems. By providing a dependable, high-capacity platform that adheres to rigorous standards, it serves as an essential tool for stabilizing manufacturing processes and qualifying incoming material lots.
High-Capacity Range: 100, 200, 300, 500, and 600 kN Models
Engineered for Metals, Composites, and Construction Materials
Advanced M2F Controller for Complex Programming
Budget-Friendly High-Capacity UTM Solution
 Request a Quote
Get personalized pricing for your specific requirements

 Description
Overview
The QM-100 to QM-600 Series features high-capacity, floor-standing universal testing machines designed for heavy-duty material analysis. As a robust yet budget-friendly universal mechanical testing machine solution, this series is engineered to deliver reliable results for high-strength applications, with capacities ranging from 100kN up to 600kN.
Features & Benefits
High-Capacity Performance: Available in 100, 200, 300, 500, and 600 kN models, these floor-type frames are built to handle the most demanding testing requirements.
Flexible Control Options: Choose between the M1F configuration for intermediate efficiency or the M2F model for advanced control, programming, and data processing capabilities.
Cost-Effective Solution: A popular choice for labs seeking a high-quality universal mechanical testing machine that balances performance with affordability.
Versatile Applications: Ideally suited for testing metals, composites, and construction materials, ensuring your lab meets rigorous industry standards.

Qualitest USA Privacy Policy 
I. What legal provisions govern our data processing practices? How and from where (internal/external sources) is personal data acquired? What are the rights of the user (web site visitor/registered customer)? 
1. General
As a general principle, no personal details need to be provided when visiting our Internet site. Data made available to us by you is treated in strict confidence and in accordance with the provisions of the Federal Data Protection Act. With a few exceptions (see point 2 below), our web server only registers non-personal (anonymous) data concerning the use of our site. Specifically, the log files of our web server, as a general rule, only contain the user's IP address, the last page visited by the user, the browser used, date, time and the file requested. This anonymous data, however, does not permit conclusions to be drawn about the individual users, and merely serves to prepare statistics on the use of our Internet site for the purpose of its improvement. At the same time, great importance is placed on ensuring that usage data is not linked with personal data. 
2. Personal data
Person-related data (personal data) is only used if the newsletter is ordered (by email), product(s) is (are) ordered, or to supply product information. We undertake to use the personal data entrusted to us only for the purposes stated. Purchase history is retained for assistance with future customer needs. 
II. What security measures are used to protect personal data? What are the user's options for processing personal data? 
3. Technical measures
Databases are optimally protected against third party access, loss, misuse and falsification through the use of appropriate technical means. In order to determine the popularity of individual topic areas, cookies are used in those sections. These text files are stored on your hard disk and facilitate your use of our Internet site. Thanks to these cookies, there is no need for specific registration each time you visit a section requiring registration, and we can supply you with the personalized contents you request. 
It is for you to decide whether you want to work with cookies and, if so, which kind (permanently stored on the hard disk or only placed for the time of the browser activity). However, we draw your attention to the fact that access to fields requiring registration is only possible with activated cookies. 
III. What data is communicated to third parties and for what purposes? 
4. Communication of personal data
Personal data entrusted to us by you is not communicated, leased or sold to third parties. 
IV. Which department answers questions about the processing of personal data? 
5. Contact
